metadata.title: That 1 kill where I aimed for a snack but Valorant said ‘Here, take this’ LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just get a kill while doing literally nothing?
My aim was on vacation, enemy decided to cooperate.
Click if your best plays come with zero effort!
Valorant’s logic is the real MVP here.

Tap if your kills are pure accident gold!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
